verdict.rationale: Railway offers per-PR preview environments and Slack/Discord alerts, but nothing in the evidence shows teammates or collaborators can comment directly on preview or production environments. Commenting on deployments is a fair axis for a deployment platform, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'; the preview and notification features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let teammates and collaborators comment directly on preview and production environments
